game.core.world.secret.summary: Ganji's catlike traits have no confirmed cause -- mutation, old curse, or something dormant in the buried past of the region. Several pages about his family were deliberately removed from the Tensor Sect's own records, and even the Sect doesn't fully understand why. Ganji himself assumes his birth parents abandoned him simply because of how he looked, and isn't especially curious to learn otherwise -- but the truth (if the GM chooses to reveal one) has never been told to him.
